data.title: Turkish government using AI tool to predict alleged ‘terrorist group’ links - Stockholm Center for Freedom
data.description: Turkey’s justice ministry is deploying artificial intelligence to scrutinize legal documents for associations with groups designated as terrorists by Ankara, a practice that experts fear will reinforce the judiciary’s documented pattern of serious rights violations, Turkish Minute reported. The ministry refers to this initiative as the Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office Organization Prediction Project. Created by […]
